proposals.description: Hardcoded API keys and credentials in source code
proposals.rationale: Exposes sensitive authentication information to anyone with access to the codebase, creating a critical security vulnerability
proposals.proposed_action: Move all API keys, passwords, and credentials to secure environment variables or configuration management systems

proposals.description: Unvalidated user input leads to potential SQL injection vulnerability
proposals.rationale: Direct concatenation of user input into SQL queries allows malicious actors to execute arbitrary database commands
proposals.proposed_action: Implement parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database interactions

proposals.description: Inefficient database queries with N+1 select problem
proposals.rationale: Multiple database round trips for related data cause significant performance degradation under load
proposals.proposed_action: Implement eager loading or batch queries to reduce database round trips

proposals.description: Missing data validation and sanitization in user input processing
proposals.rationale: Lack of input validation can lead to data corruption, loss, or injection attacks that compromise data integrity
proposals.proposed_action: Add comprehensive input validation, sanitization, and error handling for all user-provided data

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions and code style across modules
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent code style reduces maintainability and makes it harder for developers to understand the codebase
proposals.proposed_action: Enforce consistent naming conventions and code style through automated linting and code review processes

proposals.description: Missing CSRF protection in web forms
proposals.rationale: Lack of CSRF tokens makes the application vulnerable to cross-site request forgery attacks
proposals.proposed_action: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing requests and validate them on the server side

proposals.description: Missing data backup and recovery procedures
proposals.rationale: Lack of automated backup mechanisms and disaster recovery plans puts critical data at risk of permanent loss during system failures or security incidents
proposals.proposed_action: Implement automated backup schedules, offsite storage, and comprehensive recovery procedures with regular testing

proposals.description: Inconsistent naming conventions and code formatting
proposals.rationale: Inconsistent code style reduces maintainability and makes it harder for team members to understand and contribute to the codebase
proposals.proposed_action: Enforce consistent naming conventions and code formatting through linters and code review standards

proposals.description: Missing input sanitization for XSS protection
proposals.rationale: User-generated content displayed without proper sanitization creates vulnerability to cross-site scripting attacks that could compromise user sessions
proposals.proposed_action: Implement proper input sanitization and output encoding for all user-generated content before rendering in web interfaces

proposals.description: Hardcoded API keys and credentials in configuration files
proposals.rationale: Storing sensitive credentials in source code creates severe security vulnerabilities and violates security best practices
proposals.proposed_action: Move all API keys, passwords, and credentials to secure environment variables or a dedicated secrets management system
